title: The Labyrinth of Names
answer: Press B to enter the alignment-specific rank maze. The maze is not a mutually exclusive class path: reachable nodes form branching routes, and attunement determines which unlocked title is active. Innate powers receive rank-specific reach, duration, strength and transformation rules. Spells and crystal powers deliberately do not scale from player rank; artifacts use only their explicit artifact or apotheosis modifiers.
